articles.title: Tears of relief? Messi adds another incredible chapter to World Cup career
articles.summary: Argentina great Lionel Messi sheds tears as they fight back to beat Egypt and reach the World Cup quarter-finals.

articles.title: England players to get hoarding warning after freak Henderson injury
articles.summary: England players will be advised not to jump over advertising hoardings after Jordan Henderson suffered a freak injury.

articles.title: Fifa investigating alleged racist abuse of IShowSpeed
articles.summary: Fifa has opened an investigation following allegations of racist abuse involving American social media influencer IShowSpeed and a supporter during Argentina's 3-2 win over Cape Verde on Friday.

articles.title: La Liga chief critical of 'complicit silence' surrounding Fifa
articles.summary: La Liga president Javier Tebas has criticised the "complicit silence" which surrounds Fifa after the Folarin Balogun controversy.

articles.title: Fifa's Balogun decision could lead to football 'cesspit' - McAllister
articles.summary: Uefa vice-president Laura McAllister says there is a risk of "an absolute cesspit" of political interference in football after USA striker Folarin Balogun avoided a ban at the World Cup.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran plays gig for England squad as he backs team for World Cup glory
Argentina come from two down to beat Egypt in World Cup classic
articles.summary: Argentina produced an astonishing comeback to keep their World Cup alive as they recovered from two down to beat Egypt 3-2 in stoppage-time.

articles.title: Egypt boss slams 'unfair' officiating and claims World Cup 'directed towards Argentina'
articles.summary: Egypt head coach Hossam Hassan said the referee was "unfair" and claimed the World Cup was "directed towards Argentina" following their dramatic 3-2 defeat in the last 16.
